blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The finishers’ medals for the Cebu Marathon 2027 have arrived at the organizers’ warehouse, more than two months before race day, marking an early step in the new organizing team’s efforts to prevent a repeat of the medal distribution controversies that marred previous editions. DJT Events, the race’s new organizer, announced the delivery on Tuesday, October 27. They posted photos on social media of the medals being unloaded from a courier and brought into its warehouse. The early arrival follows the organizers’ promise last August that the medals would be ready ahead of the race. READ MORE: Cebu Marathon […]...
